value.rule: Choose one action for the complete service brief; all mandatory limits apply at every condition. Requirement levels are drawn under P; VALUE-BAR-V1 needs two sources and labelled ranges.

decisions.recommendation: Select one recovery contour minimizing total-pressure loss across a complete service brief, subject to buyer separation/recovery and envelope limits. State Pa/W value, duty, workflow latency and actual decision volume; adjacent published workflows do not supply acceptance numbers.
decisions.blocks: Accepted buyer question, hard limits and value claim

value.rule: Adopt research's proposed grammar, DOFs and precision prospectively; register DEVELOPMENT endpoint assumptions before truth. No silent scope narrowing.

decisions.recommendation: Approve a connected monotone recovery-contour grammar, DOFs, dimensional envelope, precision, curvature/clearance and boundary-design registration. Research range endpoints are assumptions, not approved cases.
decisions.blocks: Exact action bank and registered geometry tuples

value.rule: Adopt the source conventions and research-proposed DEVELOPMENT condition support; never infer absent endpoints from a source point.
value.support: NASA Re_H/Mach/developed-inlet conventions; proposed research ranges

decisions.recommendation: Bind density/viscosity law, Re_H/U_ref versus Re_theta conventions, full developed inlet/turbulence profile, Mach and outlet pressure with source-supported applicability. Derive expansion ratio from source geometry.
decisions.blocks: Supported service tuples and reference applicability

value.rule: REPRESENTATIVE, internal-only, uniform joint distribution over the accepted envelope. Calibrate requirement levels on public development evidence so each stratum has 20–80% passing, meaningful margin spread, a feasible design and changing answers. Exclude all catalogue anchors/equivalents. Freeze the calibrated law before candidate outcomes. Independent unit: complete service brief.

decisions.recommendation: Register joint service and continuous buyer-requirement distributions on accepted support, with explicit anchor/copy exclusions; grid stays an audit baseline. Document independent question unit and correlations.

value.rule: Register before truth: nominal 0.40, corners 0.20, frontier 0.30, transition 0.10. Track rejections; no redraw of settled NONE_FEASIBLE. Weights never repair absent coverage.

decisions.recommendation: Register nominal/corner/frontier/transition allocations and rejection law before truth, retain supported coverage; no redraw of settled NONE_FEASIBLE and no zero-support correction by weights.

value.rule: Buyer frequency under P; diagnostic weights are separate and never enter score. A mandatory failure at any condition cannot be compensated.

decisions.recommendation: State buyer scenario frequency versus diagnostic estimation weights; select mean or worst loss objective separately. Never compensate a mandatory stratum failure.

value.rule: Adopt the packet's observer contract. Tie-equivalence equals 0.5 × minimum useful improvement.
value.observables: mass-flow-weighted total-pressure loss Pa and dynamic-pressure normalization; shifted Cp is not loss

decisions.recommendation: Freeze mass-flow-weighted total-pressure planes/loss in Pa, dynamic-pressure normalization, signed shear/crossing policy and Cp shift metadata; shifted Cp is not total-pressure loss. Define objective aggregation, secondary and tie-equivalence units.

value.rule: Adopt proposed immutable source pins, conditional on complete dependency/image/deck/observer pins and passing CODE-VERIFICATION-MMS-01. A source pin alone never authorizes dispatch.
value.model_mapping: NASA SSTm; must verify exact option mapping

decisions.recommendation: Use proposed SU2 source bc15466602a687d6fb796d5df7a12ce3fde0949a only after a dependency/image/deck/observer pin and explicit NASA SSTm option mapping. Register mesh/wall/inlet/outlet sensitivity ladder and CPU execution policy.

value.rule: Code order inside the registered band. Last-two-rung decision observable difference < 0.5 × minimum useful improvement, unchanged pick and verdict. Cross-tool picks agree and regret difference < tie-equivalence. Only independent non-hidden, non-tuning witnesses; target is not an earned tier.
value.target: NASA reattachment within published experimental uncertainty, for that observable only; no general reality claim

decisions.recommendation: Set unit-bearing code/convergence/conservation and cross-tool pointwise plus verdict/pick/regret thresholds. Target Tier 2 against the confirmed buyer tool; NASA reattachment data validate only their stated observable/scope. Independent witnesses never use hidden/tuning cases.
decisions.blocks: Reference adequacy and earned credibility tier

value.rule: Freeze full rights-audited reconstructable anchor/tutorial/derivative catalogue before outcomes, including coverage gaps. No cherry-picking.

decisions.recommendation: Freeze audited reconstructable public anchors, tutorial geometries and derivative catalogue, rights, coverage gaps and supported exclusion scope before candidate outcomes.

value.rule: Adopt packet descriptors and physically valid symmetry groups; remeshing/resampling/valid rescaling are not novelty. An order-swapping mirror is not automatically equivalent.

decisions.recommendation: Use normalized wall-contour and expansion/feature descriptors plus separate log-Re_H, Mach and inlet-profile components; freeze x/H window, floors, quadrature and physically valid coordinate/scaling group. Remeshing is never new physics.

value.rule: Require geometry/mask novelty AND public decision evidence that the anchor answer/cached map no longer makes the same admissible decision. Conditions-only changes never rescue a copy. Component threshold is the smallest distance where the registered decision test passes, set and recorded from measurement.

decisions.recommendation: Register component weights, per-component thresholds and far-enough predicate against every complete catalogue entry, with mandatory geometry novelty; changing only Re must not rescue an anchor copy. Unknown coverage/rules are UNRESOLVED.
decisions.blocks: Scored-case eligibility and hidden bank construction

value.rule: At least five feasible and five infeasible designs within two accepted refinement bands; band width = minimum useful improvement. Add frontier actions, never widen bands. Power and false alarm follow #1045.

decisions.recommendation: Use Test Lead working five feasible/five infeasible within two accepted refinement bands, adding frontier resolution rather than wider bands. Set band widths, meaningful margin spread, winner diversity, close-call/refinement policy, power/false-alarm/dependence and tie acceptance.
decisions.blocks: T2/T3, accepted value check and decision-equivalence claim

value.rule: E = 1. k, m, n come from #1045-style public development power analysis; B from per-Challenge cost/cadence rule. Requirement-only variants do not renew exposure.

decisions.recommendation: Set questions k, actions m, independent units n, exposure E and bank B explicitly; B=10n is a plan only. Threshold-only variants reuse E. Report expected winner diversity from the bank under the accepted law, not grid cardinality.
decisions.blocks: Bank sizing, exposure and batch-cost/power registration

value.rule: Adopt packet panel/reuse method. Expand exact tuples, audit every attempted solve and completed/scheduled reuse, register on main; unknown index is unknown, not zero.

decisions.recommendation: Expand exact public action-condition-reference-observer-rung tuples after support acceptance; check all completed and scheduled solves, compatible reuse, total launch count and attempted costs; register digest on main. No claim of zero prior work without an index.

value.rule: Rights-clear public TRAIN on the same envelope, disjoint from panel; kit domain check must cover 100% of panel before evidence. No arbitrary evaluator execution.

decisions.recommendation: Provide training-kit domain coverage, approved disjoint TRAIN, bounded rebuild vocabulary/resources and legal source/asset use; no public access to protected data and no arbitrary reference-execution permission.

value.rule: All seven readiness items YES before evidence spend. Initial measurement pilot capped at EUR10 per family; subsequent bank decision uses team cost-benefit and EUR500 maximum. Admission only after VALUE-BAR-V1 against strongest cheap baseline and equal-budget search. Priority after battery v3/motor/f02. These recorded ceilings are not dispatch or qualification.

decisions.recommendation: Require seven-item evidence readiness, exact resource/spend grant and retained artifacts before runs. Measure actual costs: research high EUR209.61 exceeds EUR100 startup target. Select keep/reframe/replace only after reference/value and strong-baseline/equal-budget evidence; no automatic admission.
